en_US.title: Terminal Voice Register Rule
en_US.scanner: A terminal can be cruel by being precise.
en_US.field_note: Use short lines, procedural nouns, passive liability language and hard constraints. Avoid jokes unless Marauder-authored.
en_US.terminal: REGISTER: cold, compressed, actionable. No narrator moralizing. No tutorial prose disguised as corporate text.
en_US.audio: The terminal does not care that it is horrifying.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Terminal Voice Register Rule keeps in-game technical text diegetic, useful and cold.
en_US.external_site: Terminal Voice Register Rule separates HECTON-8's text surfaces: corporate packets are cold, Marauder notes are practical, Atlas traces are category errors.
